requirements.summary: Create a new Unified Preview screen that shows all three products in a responsive combined layout with cover, title/subtitle, and description (snippet/expandable).
acceptanceCriteria: From within the app, there is a clearly labeled navigation option "Unified Preview" that opens the combined preview screen.
The Unified Preview screen shows three product sections/cards on one page (responsive: stacked on small screens, multi-column on larger screens).
Each product section includes at minimum: cover image thumbnail, product name, subtitle (if present), and a short description snippet or expandable description area.
All user-facing text introduced by this change is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a new UnifiedPreviewScreen component that renders three product cards in a responsive grid. Each card should show the product cover thumbnail (via getCoverPath), name, subtitle (when non-empty), and a description snippet with an English-labeled expand/collapse control.
Extend the app view-state to include a "unifiedPreview" view and render UnifiedPreviewScreen when selected, while keeping existing editor/export behavior intact.

Add a clearly labeled "Unified Preview" navigation control in the header and wire it via new props (e.g., currentView support + onUnifiedPreviewClick) so users can open the Unified Preview screen from within the app.
Ensure the generated cover asset is present as a static frontend asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/product-cover-1.dim_1600x2560.png.
Ensure the generated cover asset is present as a static frontend asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/product-cover-2.dim_1600x2560.png.
Ensure the generated cover asset is present as a static frontend asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/product-cover-3.dim_1600x2560.png.

requirements.summary: Show an in-app PDF preview per product on the Unified Preview screen using existing generated PDF blobs, with a clear empty state when not generated and no object URL leaks.
acceptanceCriteria: If a generated PDF blob exists for a product, the Unified Preview screen renders a PDF preview panel for that product (using the existing PDF preview approach).
If a generated PDF blob does not exist for a product, the Unified Preview screen shows a non-error empty state (e.g., "Generate the product to see a PDF preview").
Preview panels do not leak object URLs (URLs are revoked when no longer needed / on unmount).

file_operations.description: Within each product card, render PdfPreviewPanel using the already-generated PDF blob when available, and pass null when not generated so the existing empty state is shown.

Confirm object URL lifecycle handling remains correct (create on blob present; revoke on cleanup/unmount and on blob changes) and ensure the empty state text remains a clear, non-error English message.

requirements.summary: Integrate Unified Preview into the existing view-state flow so navigation preserves in-memory generated bundles and works for partial generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Unified Preview screen does not clear or regenerate existing bundles; returning to Export or Editor preserves the same generated bundle blobs and metadata.
If the user generated only one product (single-bundle export), the Unified Preview screen still works and shows that product as generated and the others as not generated.
The app continues to function with the existing Editor and Export views unchanged in behavior (aside from adding the new navigation path).

file_operations.description: Preserve generatedBundles in App-level state across view switches; add handlers to navigate to/from Unified Preview without mutating generatedBundles. Ensure Unified Preview receives the current generatedBundles array so it can detect which products have PDFs.

Wire header navigation so users can enter Unified Preview from Editor/Export and exit back (e.g., provide a back control in the screen and/or a header control that switches views), without resetting any existing app state.

Implement product-to-bundle matching by productId so that if only one bundle exists (single-bundle export), that product shows a PDF preview and the other two show the empty state; also include clear English navigation controls to return to Editor/Export as appropriate.
